description:
ABOUT LIQUID AI

Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across deployment targets, from data center accelerators to on-device hardware, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We are scaling rapidly and need exceptional people to help us get there.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Liquid Console and our API let developers use Liquid’s models in their own applications. We’re looking for a product engineer to make our hosted inference API more reliable under production load and easier to adopt, from a developer’s first successful request to running a critical workflow.

You’ll build and operate the distributed services behind the API and ship improvements to the Console across onboarding, usage, credits, and billing. You’ll work with inference engineers, go-to-market teammates, and customers to decide what to fix first and take those improvements from discovery through production.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We need someone who:

 - You turn ambiguity into action. You can start with a customer problem, identify the constraints that matter, and deliver without waiting for a fully specified ticket.

 - You care about the whole product. You think beyond whether a feature works in isolation to how developers discover it, integrate it, and rely on it when something goes wrong.

 - You know what to fix first. You use production data and customer feedback to distinguish urgent problems from nice-to-haves. You ship iteratively and know when a system needs a more durable fix.




THE WORK

 - Build, scale, and operate the distributed services behind Liquid’s public inference API. Improve observability, investigate production issues, and make tradeoffs across reliability, latency, and cost.

 - Make it easier for developers to get from sign-up to a successful API request. Improve onboarding, API access, and how the product explains errors and limits.

 - Build self-serve Console features for usage, credits, billing, and account management, with clear interfaces backed by dependable services.

 - Work with inference engineers to diagnose issues that span the API and model-serving stack. Use customer feedback and production data to prioritize fixes and verify that they worked.




DESIRED EXPERIENCE

What you'll need:

 - Hands-on experience building and operating a distributed, customer-facing API or service in production, including instrumenting it, debugging failures, and scaling it under load.

 - Familiarity with AI model APIs or inference, and the developer workflows around integrating them.

 - Experience owning a project end to end, from an ambiguous problem through rollout and iteration, with the ability to work across backend services and customer-facing interfaces.

 - Sound product judgment and clear communication. You can explain what you chose to build, what you deferred, and why.

Helpful, not required:

 - Experience building developer platforms, public APIs, or self-serve products.

 - Familiarity with model serving, GPU inference, or the workflows developers use to integrate model APIs.

 - Experience working on a small team or an early-stage product where priorities evolve quickly.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (YEAR ONE)

 - You own a critical part of the inference API in production, from shipping changes to diagnosing issues under real customer traffic.

 - You’ve measurably improved a reliability or operability problem, such as reducing timeouts or making incidents faster to diagnose.

 - You’ve shipped a Console improvement that removes a recurring obstacle to adoption, and you can show how it made a developer workflow better.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Direct product impact: Help shape the Console and API that connect customers to Liquid’s models, with ownership from the first customer conversation through production.

 - Compensation & Equity: Competitive base salary plus equity, so you share in what we build. Final offers reflect skills, experience, and location.

 - Time Off: Unlimited PTO, plus company-wide Refill Days, long weekends when the whole company rests together.

 - Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive health coverage, with details varying by location.

 - Paid Leave: Paid leave for pregnancy, parenting, medical needs, and caring for family.
